description: Sends an e-mail invitation to join one of your companies with a role (viewer, member, admin or owner). Owners can invite any role; admins only member or viewer. The invitation expires in 7 days; the link is only in the e-mail and is not shown here. A company can have at most 25 members including pending invitations. Call without confirm first for a preview, then again with confirm and the preview_token.

confirm.description: Set true only on the second call, after the user approved the preview.

email.description: E-mail address of the person to invite.

locale.description: Language of the invitation e-mail. Default en.

preview_token.description: The preview_token returned by the first call (same input).

name: company_invite_create
title: Invite someone to a company
